title: IngestResult
description: What one ingest run did. New leads need a summary; everything else is counted.

not_modified.description: The source answered 304: nothing new since the last fetch.

sightings.description: Copies joined to an existing lead (same text or near-duplicate).

known.description: Items whose canonical URL was already in the lead pool.

dropped.description: Items refused by the paper tier rules (flagged) or with no text.

retiered.description: Stored papers raised to tier 1 from enrichment.
